answer: Because the horizon weight is recomputed from the glacier history each close, the orchard audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for each extra identity, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 9 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 22% of full weight. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
